resources.string:
A phone you connected to says it runs a newer MeshLive. That is only its claim.

Update through F-Droid when you have a connection. Without one, ask that phone's owner to open Help and tap Share app nearby (or to share the app another way). This version of MeshLive cannot check a file before you install it, so only install a file from a person you trust, and cancel if Android offers to Install a new app instead of Update this one. Android only accepts an update signed by the same publisher as your copy, so a copy from the MeshLive release page cannot update an F-Droid install.

MeshLive itself downloads and installs nothing.
